sloka: अथ नष्टे सहस्राक्षे उद्विग्नमभवज्जगत् ।भूमिश्च ध्वस्तसङ्काशा निःस्नेहा शुष्ककानना ।। ७.८६.४ ॥
transliteration: atha naṣṭe sahasrākṣe udvignamabhavajjagat ।bhūmiśca dhvastasaṅkāśā niḥsnehā śuṣkakānanā ।। 7.86.4 ॥

translations.english: Then, with the disappearance of the thousand-eyed Indra, the world became distressed, and the earth appeared devastated, devoid of moisture, and with dry forests.
translations.hindi: जितेन्द्रिय महाबलवान शत्रुघ्न जी, देवताओं के इन बचर्नों को सुन, सिर झुका और हाथ जोड़ कर, बोले
